Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly shifted the answer from 1999 to 2000 by inventing a “majority-of-exposure normalization” based on chart activity into early 2000. This ignored clear evidence that the promo (Guns N’ Roses’ “Oh My God” tied to End of Days) was released and serviced to radio in November 1999, the same year the film premiered, as supported by Wikipedia, Billboard chart dates in November 1999, IMDb, and Rolling Stone.
